props.heading: About Apex Plumbing & HVAC
props.story:
Apex Plumbing & HVAC started in 2009 when founder Mike Torres left a national chain to build something better: a local company that treats every home like its own.

Fifteen years later, we're still family-owned, still answering our own phones, and still showing up on time. Our team of 12 licensed technicians serves over 500 households a year across Portland, Lake Oswego, Beaverton, and Tigard.

We believe in transparent pricing, clean work sites, and repairs that last. Every job comes with a written estimate before we start and a satisfaction guarantee after we finish.
props.mission: To deliver honest, reliable home comfort services that our neighbors can count on — day or night.
